plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the wave of mystery drone sightings over New Jersey in 2024, citing a Rolling Stone article, a man named Greg Scaduto, and comments from President Donald Trump. Michels says the remarks seemed to imply the objects were coming from underwater, and that around that time there were sightings off the coast where UAPs, the government's term for unidentified objects, seemed to be coming up out of the water. If true, it would point to something hiding in the ocean.
